title: Seeing Wiggs at the 1973 Jazz Club anniversary and his later death
summary: Steinau saw Wiggs play on his honeymoon, where Wiggs mistook him for his father; he also recalls a radio announcer's memorial after Wiggs died.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
